title: D-GAP: Improving Out-of-Domain Robustness via Dataset-Agnostic and Gradient-Guided Augmentation in Frequency and Pixel Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2511.11286v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Out-of-domain (OOD) robustness is challenging to achieve in real-world computer vision, especially in unsupervised domain adaptation scenarios, where shifts in image background, style, and acquisition instruments often degrade model performance. Generic augmentations show inconsistent gains under such shifts, whereas dataset-specific augmentations require expert knowledge and prior analysis. Moreover, prior studies show that neural networks adapt poorly to domain shifts because they exhibit a learning bias to domain-specific frequency components. Perturbing frequency values can mitigate such bias but overlooks pixel-level details, leading to suboptimal performance. To address these limitations, we propose D-GAP, a Dataset-agnostic and Gradient-guided augmentation method for the Amplitude spectrum (in frequency space) and the Pixel values. translated_title: D-GAP：通过数据集无关且梯度引导的频率与像素空间增强提升域外鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 在现实世界的计算机视觉中，实现域外鲁棒性极具挑战性，尤其是在无监督域适应场景下，图像背景、风格和采集设备的变化往往会降低模型性能。通用增强方法在此类变化下的收益并不稳定，而针对特定数据集的增强方法则需要专家知识和先验分析。此外，先前的研究表明，神经网络难以适应域变化，原因在于它们对特定域的频率分量存在学习偏差。对频率值进行扰动可以缓解这种偏差，但忽略了像素级的细节，导致性能欠佳。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了D-GAP，一种数据集无关且由梯度引导的增强方法，作用于幅度谱（频率空间）和像素值。与传统的手工设计增强方法不同，D-GAP通过在频率……
tldr: D-GAP提出了一种数据集无关、由梯度引导的增强方法，同时扰动频率空间的幅度谱和像素值，从而有效提升无监督域适应场景下的域外鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: D-GAP is a dataset-agnostic, gradient-guided augmentation method that perturbs both the amplitude spectrum in frequency space and pixel values to improve out-of-domain robustness in unsupervised domain adaptation.
